connector.name: Forge MCP by frmoded
connector.registryDescription: MCP server + tools for the Forge E-- generative-music authoring loop (compile / run / commit).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package forge-recipe-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the frmoded account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: FORGE_TRANSPILE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the forge-transpile service. Provides /catalog, /compile, /run, /resolve-slot endpoints backing the read/author tools.

env.name: FORGE_VAULT_PATH
env.description: Local vault directory used by forge_read_notes_in_vault + forge_commit_recipe. Must exist and be writable.

env.name: FORGE_MCP_BEARER
env.description: Bearer token forwarded to forge-transpile. Rotate by updating FORGE_TRANSPILE_SECRET on the upstream service and re-setting this. Dev fallback only when clients don't set Authorization on each request.
